::: {.section-intro}
My research sits between experimental physics and engineering: building and validating the measurement chain that turns detector signals into trustworthy physics data. Projects are listed below with their status and evidence type, distinguishing **experimental measurements** from **simulation studies**, and completed from ongoing work.
:::
